translation: One merely uses warming medicines to supplement and nourish the primordial qi; if the kidney water of the lower part becomes replete and overcomes and retreats the heart fire of the upper burner, then naturally the thirst ceases, the urine returns to normal, and the disease is cured. Such words are exactly contrary to Zhongjing; they are what is called clever words that seem right but in principle truly violate [the truth]. It is not only the error of today; it has also been so for a long time.
translator_notes: 仲景 (Zhongjing) refers to Zhang Zhongjing.
